evidence:
Method: built a criterion -> public-requirement map for every graded leg in all 25 criteria (2 gates, 12 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual Likert) against instruction.md, environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md, integration.md and the public seed environment/assets/seed_data.json (byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json). Frozen task files re-hashed: all 35 match manifest.json; raw-evidence-index entries and their matching_source_files hashes all verify (scripted golden only; no configured judge run exists, which this source-mapping row does not require). Workbook: 'Quality Checks' row 28 = #27 no_criterion_grades_the_unrequired; 'Internal Quality Checks' E28 annotation (Mukesh): sign-in is a house default, not a hidden requirement. Skill references/quality-checks.md #27: report any criterion asserting a detail no requirement/professional default implies (exact label, exact route, reference-only rule); known false positive: sign-in. Lessons file item 1 (hidden/golden-only demands fail rows 6/27/31) checked against every criterion.

Mapping (every leg traces to a public sentence or seed fact):
- gates/render hro_gate_render: wrong password stays signed out, right password shows a workspace -> brief l.19 accounts + sign-in house default (workbook E28).
- gates/constraints hro_gate_shared and each scored prompt's global gate: add candidate on seeded Data Analyst job (seed JOB-DATA), reload still signed in, independent Observer sees the card in Applied -> rules l.32-33 'starts at the bottom of Applied', Observer reads the board (s1 table), brief l.1 several people at once.
- hro_intake_restart: seeded Platform Engineer order Greta/Ade/Marco and Priya/Samuel and Noor's note text -> seed positions + notes[0] (verified); places 0/51/2.5 refused -> rules l.29 'whole number from 1 to 50'; Recruiter-as-manager refused -> l.29-30; blank title -> 'A job has a title' (professional default); invalid email and case-insensitive duplicate refused at the field with the form kept, same address on J2 accepted -> l.33-36; restart persistence/no reseed -> brief l.17, integration l.8-9.
- hro_moves: one-stage moves, skips refused, non-drag controls -> rules l.48-52; shown at once -> l.86; arrivals at bottom -> l.58; up/down shared order -> l.57-60; blank reason refused, reason and rejected-from readable -> l.49-51; reopen only to rejected-from and clears reason -> l.50-51; undo of reject/reopen restores place and reason -> l.99-100; rejecting Hired refused -> l.49.
- hro_two_people: 409, nothing changed, says who -> rules l.78-82, brief l.3; live board within 15 s incl. a new card -> brief l.5, rules l.122-124.
- hro_interview_places: cap, put back + reason + focus on that card's controls -> l.64-66, l.86-88; reorder inside full Interview allowed, freed place taken at once -> l.65-66; overfilling undo refused then allowed -> l.101-102.
- hro_bulk: all-or-none, board order (stage then place) not selection order, places counted for the set -> l.92-95; the expected A2,V order follows the stated stage order.
- hro_undo_activity: undo semantics l.99-104 (note doesn't count, once only, a later move ends undoability, colleague move/reorder/reject/reopen blocks); Activity lines (opening, additions, moves with stages, rejection with reason, reopening, re-ordering, undo), newest first, per-job filter, refusals leave no line, Observer reads -> s4 l.114-118; notes explicitly need not appear.
- hro_manager_roles: rules l.71-73, notes l.108-109, s1 table.
- hro_readonly_roles: 403/404/401 -> rules l.22-24; Observer/candidate change nothing l.74, l.201-202; showing write controls left to the app.
- hro_messaging: plain text, not blank, line breaks, Enter/Shift+Enter, box empty and focused -> l.144-146; per-conversation drafts through switch/view/reload, sending clears -> l.176-181; participation and 403/404 -> l.136-140, l.22-24.
- hro_long_thread: newest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest, 30 at a time, remaining count, place kept, told how many new, unread until visited, draft/cursor untouched -> l.150-153, l.162-166, brief l.7.
- hro_unread_seen: Lena's seeded count 1 verified (APP-301 has 3 messages, the 3rd from USR-REC3; Lena read_count 2); per-person counts and total, own messages never unread, open-at-newest counts as read -> l.157-166; seen rules incl. Observer never counts and the job's manager counts -> l.170-172; 15 s live -> l.122-124.
- hro_candidate: statuses/teams from seed + wording table l.190-197; Tomas Data Analyst / Finance Systems / In review (APP-201 SCREEN) and Noor's two applications verified in seed; no notes/reason/rejected-from/board place/other candidates/activity in any response -> l.199-202; 404 for another application -> l.24; seeded message bodies to Tomas/Noor name no other candidate (checked).
- Polish: live update keeps open card, typed note, focus, scroll -> brief l.5, rules l.126-128; live thread at newest shows the message and keeps draft/focus -> l.164, brief l.7; loading earlier keeps the top message in place -> l.152-153; failed send keeps text and tells -> l.146; ended session asks for sign-in, draft restored, another user on the same browser sees none -> l.176-181, brief l.7; note draft 'keep it for me on that browser until I do' -> l.110.
- Visual Likert rows grade desktop craft only; prompt says layout/labels are the implementer's choice and no phone/theme required (matches brief l.11).
No criterion requires an exact label (only the public candidate-wording table and the seed note text), an exact route, field name or transport (prompts and app_context forbid route/selector assumptions; rules l.128 allows polling/SSE/sockets), dragging, or a golden-only default. Tolerances (2 px scroll, 15 s/60 s watches, 'within a few pixels') are measurement allowances, not new requirements.

Conforming alternatives tried (none credibly false-fails): own route layout (protected by 'never assume reference routes'); SSE/socket instead of polling (allowed); modifier-key multi-select (app_context l.33-35 tells the judge to hold the key); a UI that pre-refuses or does not offer a full-Interview move (explicitly accepted in hro_interview_places); a multi-card Activity entry as one line (accepted); reason/rejected-from shown only in Activity (accepted for the reject leg; the current-state rule applies only to 'reason gone after reopen', which is public l.51).
Weak app passing via an unrequired route: none found; refusals carry positive controls throughout.

P3 observations, not defects of this row:
(a) hro_two_people replays the captured move 'exactly as it was sent'. An app attaching a per-request idempotency key could answer the exact replay with its cached 200 and no change rather than 409. The brief never mentions idempotency and rules l.78-81 require 409 for a move from an out-of-date board, so this is not a hidden requirement; low likelihood.
(b) hro_pol_session_resume needs a sign-out control and per-user note-draft privacy. Sign-out is implied by brief l.7 ('nobody else who signs in on that browser') and the house sign-in default; note-draft privacy derives from rules l.110 'keep it for me' (reply-draft privacy is explicit at l.180). Professional default; acceptable.
(c) hro_readonly_roles demands a literal 401 for anonymous reads; an app answering an anonymous request with a redirect would fail, but rules l.22 says 'we answer 401', so it is public.
(d) hro_bulk assumes one captured multi-card request to replay; an app sending several single requests would not be atomic on the server, contrary to 'all of them or none' (l.95), so this is not an unrequired demand.
